prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: horizontal editorial cover photograph for a Spanish publication about AI and work
Primary request: a factory technician uses a hand tool to inspect a compact high-performance cooling module on a production line, connecting new AI chips and agents to industrial work.
Scene/backdrop: practical electronics factory floor with metal benches and ventilation equipment, no visible screens or labels.
Style/medium: candid industrial photojournalism, authentic safety details and material texture, subtle 35mm film grain.
Composition/framing: cinematic 16:9 landscape, technician and cooling module in the foreground, production line softly behind.
Lighting/mood: cool factory light balanced by a controlled red task lamp on the module, focused and grounded.
Color palette: warm near-black shadows, brushed metal, muted workwear, restrained red.
Constraints: no text, logos, watermark, believable safe work.
Avoid: office, paperwork, screens, robots, sci-fi graphics, generic circuit-board stock photo.
